description: This file is a PHP template for the footer section of a web application. It includes PHP code that retrieves data such as categories, posts, and sponsors, and outputs HTML markup for footer contents including links, sponsor images, social media links, and legal information.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class providing access to application settings.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Model class for blog or news posts.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Utility class for managing translatable text strings.

methods.name: Category::getNames
methods.description: Returns an array of category IDs and names used in the project.

methods.name: Post::getList
methods.description: Returns a list of posts filtered by context such as footer.

methods.name: Sponsor::getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sponsor objects to display.

methods.name: Text::get
methods.description: Fetches localized text strings for display.

methods.name: Text::recorta
methods.description: Truncates text to a specified length.
